question:
Select the most appropriate option that can substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence.

My dad asked my mom to prepare lunch early as he was __feeling very hungry__.
solution:
The correct answer is **'starved'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The underlined segment **"feeling very hungry"** refers to the strong desire or need for food. It is a physical sensation that results from the need to eat. **("बहुत भूख लगी हुई है")**.

 
 
• **For example, **"After a long day at work, she was** feeling very hungry.**"
 
 
 
• The correct word to substitute the underlined segment is **'starved'** which means very hungry. **("भूख से बिलकुल व्याकुल")**.
 
 
• **For example, **"After the strenuous workout, the athlete felt **starved.**"
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is** 'Option 3'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **'Terrible'** is generally used to express that something is very distressing or dreadful. ("भयंकर").
 
• **'Exhausted'** means to be extremely tired, worn out or depleted. ("थका हुआ").
 
• **'Tired' **means to feel in need of rest or sleep. ("थकान").
